title: Townsend Brown's time travel tech taken by a group in Nassau

tellings.quote: Shatskin, Brown was constantly saying that his time travel technology was taken by a group in Nassau in the Bahamas.

plain: Thomas Townsend Brown, an American researcher said to have worked on anti-gravity, supposedly kept saying that a group in Nassau, in the Bahamas, had taken his time travel technology. Michels tells this from the work of the writer Paul Schatzkin, whose biography of Brown is called The Man Who Mastered Gravity, and he names a man called William Stephenson and Brown's daughter as part of the story. If true, it would mean a private group got hold of technology for moving through time.
